verdict.rationale: The Empresa Online service page names 'Cidadão estrangeiro' as a user class and states the accepted credentials: a Chave Móvel Digital linked to a passport, or European eIDAS authentication. It also lists extra steps when the shareholder is a foreign company: a Portuguese NIPC and NIF, plus the home-country commercial registry certificate. Explicit residency eligibility rules and extra steps for foreign individual founders (such as obtaining a NIF or a passport-linked Chave Móvel Digital) are not documented in the pack. Missing for 10: explicit non-resident eligibility criteria, steps for foreign individuals to obtain the required identifiers or credentials, independent or hands-on corroboration of the foreign-founder path.

support.subject: As a foreign founder, the service documents a path for a non-resident to complete this task — eligibility, acceptable foreign credentials or identifiers, and any extra steps stated on its own pages

citations.quote: Cidadão estrangeiro Com a Chave Móvel Digital associada ao passaporte ou autenticação europeia (eIDAS)
Se o sócio da empresa a criar for uma empresa estrangeira, é necessário: ter NIPC e NIF português; a certidão de Registo Comercial do país onde está localizada a sede
Escolha um meio de autenticação: Cartão de Cidadão, Chave Móvel Digital, Certificado Digital de Profissional Jurídico, Autenticação Europeia (eIDAS)
